facts.business: Manraj Housing Finance Limited is a housing finance company that did not carry out any business activities during the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Adverse opinion due to: (a) Advances to related parties under ED investigation with assets attached, raising recoverability concerns; (b) 65% liabilities as unsecured loans from related parties with beneficial interest in properties; (c) Default in repayment of bank borrowings of Rs. 687.03 lakhs transferred to ASREC (India) Ltd, with unprovided interest of Rs. 442.75 lakhs (up to March 2024) and Rs. 268.67 lakhs (FY2025-26), understating loss by Rs. 141.94 lakhs and liability by Rs. 711.42 lakhs; (d) Material uncertainty on going concern due to no significant operations for over three years, accumulated losses of Rs. 574.96 lakhs, and net worth erosion.

key_risks: Advances to related parties under Enforcement Directorate investigation with assets attached, raising significant recoverability and valuation concerns
Approximately 65% of liabilities are unsecured loans from related parties with beneficial interest in properties, creating uncertainty about completeness and accuracy of liabilities
Default in repayment of bank borrowings (Rs. 687.03 lakhs) transferred to ASREC (India) Ltd, with unprovided interest leading to understatement of loss and liabilities
Material uncertainty on going concern: no significant operational activities for over three years, accumulated losses of Rs. 574.96 lakhs, and erosion of net worth
Non-moving inventory of unsold residential shops and flats valued at Rs. 88.71 lakhs unchanged for more than three years with no sales, indicating limited marketability
facts.related_party_note: More than 9% of company's assets comprise advances, deposits, receivables, and other balances recoverable from related parties towards acquisition of properties and rights. These related parties are under ED investigation under PMLA with assets attached. Approximately 65% of liabilities are unsecured loans from related parties who have beneficial interest in the properties for which advances were given.
